questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne bo et sted udenfor Europa for at opleve noget helt andet. Her var Sydkorea oplagt, da det er billigere end fx USA og Australien og nemmere end Japan.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Universitetet var gode til at sende informative mails.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Mails fra SKKU.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Jeg havde flere muligheder men valgte Simple Spaces. Jeg ved ikke, om jeg tør anbefale dem, da flere af deres lejligheder er slidte og beskidte. Vi fik først en med en masse skimmelsvamp i, men blev derefter flyttet hurtigt til en nyrenoveret en. Fordelen ved dem er, at man har mulighed for at møde en masse andre udvekslingsstuderende, de er engelsktalende og har lejligheder på gode beliggenheder.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: At hvis du ikke gør det, er der udgangsforbud i alle hverdage (altså på uni dorms). Der er problemer med skimmelsvamp generelt i hele Seoul pga. fugtigheden og sommeren. Sæt dig godt ind i beliggenheden ved at tjekke afstande til diverse ting på kort-appen Naver Maps. Der kan være længere end man tror med offentlig. Gode områder at bo i er Hongdae, Sinchon, Mangwon, Itaewon, Haebangchon, Euljiro, Gangnam (dele af det), men hvis du har mange dage om ugen med fysisk skole, vil jeg anbefale ikke at bo for langt fra dit uni, da busturene i Seoul kan være riigtig krads i myldretiden.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det foregår kl 2 om natten dansk tid, hvor det er vigtigt, du er oppe og hurtig. Du skal have forberedt dig på hvilke fag, du vil vælge, da de hurtigt bliver taget. Mange af fagene har kun plads til 3-7 udvekslingsstuderende. Jeg fik dog alle fag, jeg ønskede på trods af få pladser.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: De svarer lynhurtigt på mail.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle dem, jeg ønskede.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Læs ovenfor.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: De fleste af dem var meget lette sammenlignet med KU. Selv i enkelt fag hvor jeg klarede mig middelmådigt, fik jeg A+.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Mere gymnasieagtig. Formelt. De tracker via iCampus (Absalon) om du læser lektier, der er flere afleveringer og fremlæggelser + mid term exam.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: International organization theory, political and economic development in korea, comparative thought and culture: west and east, social network analysis, strategic planning and perfomance management.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: political and economic development in korea og comparative thought and culture: west and east er meget informative ift. Sydkoreas historie, politik, kultur osv.

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg fik ikke udnyttet det, men det kunne godt have været mere indbydende.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Alt muligt - men det meste var til koreanske studerende.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Sport.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Jeju, Busan, Jeonju, Seoraksan, Bukhansan, Mullae.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Lidt svært tbh når man ikke snakker koreansk. Men det hjælper rigtig meget at tage i byen og drikke med de lokale, hvis man vil snakke med koreanere.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Hi club og andre clubs.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: De er ikke super glade alle sammen for at snakke engelsk og lidt generte generelt.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Maden, stemningen, bylivet, de forskellige kvarters charme og forskellighed, venlighed mm.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1) vær klar og forberedt på tilmelding til fag 2) tjek løbende din mail for deadlines 3) ikke stress over at dumpe fagene - de er meget gavmilde med karakterer 4) nyd det

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Få RC gennem uni.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Seoul som by

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Savnet til DK og folk derhjemme.
